children: Our Bureau New Delhi: State-owned NTPC Ltd's consolidated net profit for the quarter ended September was 41.1% higher on year at 7,351 crore, while consolidated revenue from operations stood at 54,270 crore, up 21% on year. The profit was supported by higher revenue. In the reporting quarter, the coal-based plants of the company on a standalone basis saw a plant load factor, which represents the units' operating levels, was 73.5% compared with 66% in the same period a year back.

title: NTPC's Q2 Profit Rises
